tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List the travel insurance guides published on checko.co.il (Hebrew), with slug, title and URL, optionally only those whose title contains a search term.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Returns the full Markdown text (Hebrew) of one published guide, identified by its slug.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Return the questions and answers from the checko.co.il FAQ (Hebrew), optionally for one category.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_guide" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return the full Markdown text (Hebrew) of one published guide, by slug from list_guides." → after: "Returns the full Markdown text (Hebrew) of one published guide, identified by its slug."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
